decisions.reason: After surviving the first review, this charting add-on likely performs around aspiration and is inexpensive to sustain within the firm's core web-mapping stack, so we would keep it.

This narrowly scoped, technology-specific mobile control component has had ample time to prove standalone demand, and if results remain below aspiration we would now free the resources for stronger core and new-development work.
Mobile field data capture fits the firm's enterprise GIS customer base and reuses existing capabilities, so its results are likely acceptable enough relative to aspiration to justify keeping it.

As a close complement to web map applications, this search extension likely still benefits from customer-project pull and organizational slack, so we would keep it unless performance clearly deteriorates below aspiration.
